title: Debian 13 GNOME overview
caption: Debian 13 (trixie), GNOME Shell 48.7, kernel 7.3.0-rc4 (t26) on the built-in 1904x3040 panel at scale 2. The Tablet settings app (Systems page) and a terminal with tb323fu-ctl battery, refresh and gpu output in the activities overview.

title: Debian 13 in landscape
caption: Debian 13 GNOME rotated to landscape (3040x1904, transform 90) with the Tablet settings app on its Performance page: GPU profile, frequency limits and live temperatures.

title: Tablet quick settings
caption: GNOME quick settings on Debian 13 with the Tablet extension menu open: battery state and charger, charge limit (60/80/100 %), bypass charging, refresh-rate mode (Adaptive, fixed 60 Hz, always 120 Hz) and the torch. Wi-Fi network name blanked.

title: Settings: Battery
caption: Tablet settings app on Debian 13, Battery page: charge limit, bypass charging and live status (charge, power, current, voltage, temperature, health, cycle count).

title: Settings: Display
caption: Tablet settings app on Debian 13, Display page: adaptive refresh rate (120 Hz, slowing to 60 then 30 Hz while the screen is still) and its timing preset.

title: Settings: Performance
caption: Tablet settings app on Debian 13, Performance page: Adreno GPU profile, per-profile frequency limits, surface/CPU/GPU temperatures and throttling state.

title: Settings: Torch & LED Ring
caption: Tablet settings app on Debian 13, Torch & LED Ring page: rear torch on/off and brightness, LED ring charge indicator, brightness and low-battery threshold.

title: Settings: Systems (multiboot)
caption: Tablet settings app on Debian 13, Systems page: the installed roots (Debian on UFS and SD, Arch Linux ARM, Fedora 44, NixOS 26.11, SteamOS, Ubuntu 26.04.1) with one-shot restart; the SD Debian root is flagged as missing modules and audio firmware for the running kernel.

title: Settings: About
caption: Tablet settings app on Debian 13, About page: helper and app version 0.1.0, kernel 7.3.0-rc4 (t26), 11 of 11 helper features available.

title: tb323fu-ctl boot list and thermal
caption: GNOME Terminal on Debian 13, kernel 7.3.0-rc4 (t26): tb323fu-ctl boot list (multiboot roots), tb323fu-ctl thermal (14 board sensors, no throttling) and systemd-analyze (6.3 s to graphical.target).
